tenantNotFoundDesc: Check the address or contact your administrator.
tryAgainLater: Please try again in a moment.
tenantSuspendedDesc: Contact the platform administrator to restore access.
mustChangeNotice: A password change is required before you continue.
policyRuleCharClasses: At least 3 of: lowercase, uppercase, numbers, symbols
policyRuleCommon: Not a common or easily guessed password
passwordPolicyFailed: The new password does not meet the password policy. It must be 10+ characters with 3 character types, not a common password, and must not contain your name, email, or current password.
mfaCodePrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfaRecoveryPrompt: Enter one of your recovery codes.
mfaUseRecovery: Can't use your code? Sign in with a recovery code
mfaCodeInvalid: Invalid or already used code. Please try again.
mfaSessionExpired: Your verification session expired. Please sign in again.
mfaDesc: Add a second sign-in step with a one-time code from an authenticator app.
mfaAlreadyEnrolled: MFA is already enabled for this account.
mfaScanQr: 1) Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
mfaConfirmCode: 2) Enter the 6-digit code from the app
mfaRecoveryWarning: These recovery codes are shown only once. Save them in a safe place — each code can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app.
mfaSavedCodes: I have saved my recovery codes
mfaDisableWarning: Your account will no longer require a second step at sign-in. Confirm with your password and a current code.
mfaForcedDesc: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Enroll now to continue using the console.

mfaGraceLink: Set it up on My Page
amaSsoSigningIn: Signing you in with your Amoeba account…
amaSsoFailedDesc: We could not verify your Amoeba session. Please sign in with your ShopTalk account below.
amaSsoNotMapped: Your Amoeba account is not registered in this workspace. Ask an administrator to invite you, or sign in below.
wrongStoreDesc: You are signing in to {{store}}. If your account belongs to a different store, you have to use that store’s own address.
lockedDesc: Sign-in is paused for a short while. Please try again later.
recoveryTempDesc: We will email a temporary password to your registered address.
recoveryTempSent: If an account exists for that email, a temporary password has been sent.
recoveryChangeDesc: Verify with your current or temporary password and set a new one. Changing it also unlocks sign-in.
recoveryChanged: Password changed. Please sign in with your new password.
recoveryRateLimited: Too many recovery attempts. Please try again later.
recoveryEmailUnavailable: Email delivery is not available. Please contact your workspace administrator.
